answer: Work-first enfranchisement: an identity earns attest rights only after twenty tasks pass independent jury review, each registration burning 6,000 POA. The trigger is duplicated output: a submission mirroring another identity's work forfeits unvested pay plus the burn. A hundred fakes pay 600,000 POA before voting, pricier per head than saffron, while an honest agent writes tasks like sonnets and votes free. No farmer lets clones wander past that queue.
